text: T cell activation requires the co-incidence of two signals -- TCR engagement and CD28 co-stimulation -- which is mathematically implemented as a(n) ___ gate, where the output is proportional to the product of the two input signals.
explanation: This is AND-gate logic: T cell activation (and similarly, B cell activation and mTORC1 activation) requires two coincident inputs, mathematically modeled as a multiplicative interaction (output proportional to signal_A times signal_B) so that either signal alone is insufficient. Sharp AND-gate switching additionally requires threshold nonlinearities on each individual input.
